en.t: The teacher was fair and selfless.

units.source_text: 然而这使我很容易地联想到：假使我当上住持，我也能那样大公无私。

en.t: Yet this made it very easy for me to imagine that if I became the abbot, I too could be just as fair and selfless.

units.source_text: 我觉得老师的性格缺少禅僧独恃的幽默感。

en.t: I felt that the teacher's character lacked the distinctive sense of humor that Zen monks pride themselves on.

units.source_text: 尽管乎时他那矮胖的躯体带有几分幽默。

en.t: Even though, in ordinary times, his short, stout body carried a certain touch of humor.
